marketplaces.subtitle: Sales channels where prices are published.

priceHistory.title: Price history
priceHistory.subtitle: Append-only log of every base or final price change.

apiKeys.subtitle: Read-only keys for the external API. The full key is shown only once.

fields.expiresAtHelp: Optional: without a date the key does not expire.

users.subtitle: Platform access and assigned role.
